name: xAI QTS Atlanta

timeline.event: X Corp's $700 million investment in AI training hardware for the Atlanta data center is approved by the Development Authority of Fulton County (bond resolution fact sheet).

xAI's GPU cluster in the QTS Atlanta building at 1025 Jefferson Street NW is operational around this time. This date is a tentative estimate: Business Insider reported the buildout in February 2025, so the cluster likely came online around…
No significant change to the building since the cluster became operational.
No significant change to the building since the August 2025 image.

sources.publisher: Epoch AI, Frontier Data Centers Hub (CC-BY)
sources.quote: xAI QTS Atlanta: current power 17.32971 MW; owner SpaceXAI.

explain: xAI QTS Atlanta is an operating AI data center in Atlanta, GA, owned by xai. Epoch AI estimates it draws 17 MW today and 24 MW when finished.
